$description: The landing page's settings and demo content. build.mjs reads this, fills src/index.html and writes dist/. Page copy lives in src/index.html; the beaver comes from the app's own sprite; What's new comes from GitHub Releases at build time.

releases.$description: The newest published release lists up to latestItems of its bold lead lines, each with its first sentence; the ones before it get a row each, up to earlier, summed up by up to summaryLeads leads. The APK is the release asset matching apkPattern.

chores.$description: The hero's to-do list. Each chore's steps play in turn under it; the last step stays as its receipt once the chore is struck through.
